reserves.name: USDC deployed through the autoUSD Autopool and destination vaults
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Auto Finance Autopool strategy and configured DeFi destinations

reserveReview.rationale: Auto Finance documents Autopools as ERC-4626-style receipt tokens whose base asset is deployed across one or more configured destination vaults and returned in the base asset on withdrawal. The official registry identifies autoUSD at 0xa7569A44f348d3D70d8ad5889e50F78E33d80D35; the position is therefore retained as a full USDC wrapper exposure while the strategy-level destination allocation remains inside the aggregate protocol position.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Auto Finance autoUSD Autopool architecture and official contract registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The base USDC dependency and Autopool structure are explicit, but current destination vaults, allocation weights, unwind times, and strategy counterparties are not published in the reviewed static documentation.
